messages.subject: Error in detectionHistory: encountered a bug. I'm Sorry. Please report it.
parts:
Hi All,

I'm generating detection histories and have encountered the following error: "Error in detectionHistory(recortTable = dat, camOp = sc_camops, species = Island Fox", : encountered a bug. I'm Sorry. Please report it." The strange thing is that detectionHistory worked fine generating detection histories for this species with occasionLength = 7 or 14, the error only arises when I try to generate a detectionHistory with occasionLength = 1. Also strange because I can generate a detectionHistory with occasionLength = 1 for the other species in the data set with no problem. Below is the code, attached are images of the record table and camops table.

Thanks,
Ellie

# Record Table
#make fox and skunk record tables for 7 days, 14 days. 1 day for skunks, 1 day for foxes encountered a bug. Strange.


detectionHistory(recordTable = dat,
                             camOp = sc_camops,
                           species = "Island Fox", 
                           stationCol = "Label",
                           speciesCol = "Species",
                           recordDateTimeCol = "Date.Time",
                           recordDateTimeFormat = "%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p", #super important to get this formatting correct
                           occasionLength = 1,#in days, did 1, 7, 14 days
                           day1 = "station", #means the day the station was set
                           includeEffort = FALSE,
                           scaleEffort = FALSE,
                           timeZone = "US/Pacific",
                           writecsv = TRUE,
                           outDir = "data/cam"
)

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error in detectionHistory: encountered a bug. I'm Sorry. Please report it.
parts:
Hi Ellie,
I can't see a problem with your code and can't figure out what the issue might be here without seeing the actual data.
The error is raised when camtrapR calculates more occasions for your species than there are columns in the effort matrix calculated internally. Nevermind the details, it should not happen. 
Would you mind sharing the Island Fox subset of your data and the camera operation matrix please? If you don't wish to share publicly please free to email it to me (either the csvs or an R workspace). Then I can go and find what is going on here.
Thank you,
Jürgen

messages.author: d8e262ed65ee2e05
messages.subject: Re: Error in detectionHistory: encountered a bug. I'm Sorry. Please report it.
parts:
Hi Jürgen,

Thank you so much for your reply! Your description of the error helped me figure out what was wrong and how to fix it:

The dates in the camera operations matrix and species record table must not have matched up. I was using a fake camera operations table- I just generated perfect operations for a set of dates I was interested in. However, the retrieval date that I set still in the camops matrix was one day short, as I had detections of island foxes (but not my other species) on that date in the record table. My guess is that's why I only got the error when I tried to generate 1-day histories for island foxes.

Thanks to you and Phillip for your quick responses!

Best,
Ellie
